record.short: Bare Metal starting price drops from $100 to $90/month, but it has flipped between $90 and $100 repeatedly, so this may be a test rather than a settled cut.

record.short: Data Engine, previously included as Limited access in the $25/mo Pro plan, becomes a standalone product on a waitlist with no listed price.

One highlighted Professional bullet was swapped for another; no entitlement or price change is shown.

record.plan: Advanced and Express Pro, 2yr+4mo intro term
record.headline: ExpressVPN cut its intro price on the 2yr+4mo term to $3.99/mo for Advanced and $5.99/mo for Express Pro.
record.who: New subscribers choosing the 2yr+4mo intro term on Advanced or Express Pro; annual renewal rates are unchanged.
record.read: A deeper multi-year discount pulls the headline monthly price down without touching renewal rates, so it mainly sharpens the sign-up offer against rival VPNs. The effect is on the intro term only.
record.caveat: Intro-term prices only; the page does not say how long this level will last.

promo.text: AgentSource 2.0 launch promo, 20% off all packages, ended
